description: Build the guest session's one voice profile from the person's own writing and start the stylometric extraction (45 measured attributes). Samples MUST be their own human-written prose. You can use writing you already hold for them (messages they typed to you, documents or emails they shared, posts of theirs you can read): their exact words, never your memory notes or summaries about them, and never text you or another AI wrote or rewrote. Tell the person which pieces you are sending before you call this; the result's samples_used lists each piece's first line and word count so you can show them. 1-20 samples, each under 5,000 words, 25,000 words in all; a sample needs 50+ words to count; 3+ samples totalling 3,000+ words gives a confident profile. Extraction usually takes under a minute: poll get_profile until status is 'complete'. The result carries claim_url for the person.

english_variant.description: British (uk) or American (us) spelling. Defaults to uk.

samples.description: The person's own writing, one string per piece.
